sections.content: Web Components are native browser features for reusable custom elements: custom elements (<my-card>), Shadow DOM (encapsulated styles), HTML templates, and slots.
They work in any framework — or no framework — because the browser implements them directly. Libraries like Lit make authoring pleasant.
Key points: shadow DOM isolates styles from the page, slots enable composition, and custom elements need a hyphenated name like <user-card>.
